accepted_width_uncertainty_basis: Bootstrap resampling of the selected off-pulse bins, with a fresh baseline/noise estimate per Monte Carlo trial.
toa_topo_mjd_uncertainty_basis: Half of the effective time bin after reduction; TOA is anchored to the selected peak bin rather than a fitted centroid model.
width_ms_acf_uncertainty_basis: Half of the effective time sample used to evaluate the temporal ACF crossing.
spectral_width_mhz_acf_uncertainty_basis: Half of the effective channel width used to evaluate the spectral ACF crossing.
peak_flux_jy_uncertainty_basis: Radiometer-noise statistical term from one off-pulse sigma in the selected band.
fluence_jyms_uncertainty_basis: Radiometer-noise statistical term from the event-window sum over off-pulse-normalized bins.
dm_uncertainty_basis: Quadratic width from the local DM score peak. FLITS still evaluates the sweep with integer-bin dedispersion on the active analysis grid, so this width is a heuristic local-fit diagnostic rather than a publishable 1-sigma DM uncertainty.
